dimensions.explanation: The selected control concerns STR submissions by the three expressly defined categories of licensed firms. It does not determine obligations of other reporting persons.
Licensed firms is expressly defined; STREAMS 2, XML and e-Cert are identified. The technical XML schema and prescribed PDF specification are not supplied.

Urgent direct contact applies during blackout. Footnote 3 attaches to XML and PDF through their markers; extending it to the web form lacks comparable textual support. Resubmission is a separate obligation, not express permission for alternative channels.
Required submission and resubmission are distinguished from should register and the blackout instruction to contact JFIU. The text does not say that contact alone completes an STR filing.

Read the general effective date with the specific 9:00am launch on 2 February 2026. Blackout begins at 12:00am on 28 January and continues until resumption. Date-only expressions cannot directly encode these intraday boundaries.

Missing schema, prescribed form details and resubmission guidance limit implementation-level conclusions. The four dependency identifiers have no supplied contents or mapping to particular references.

assumptions: The control evaluates an identified STR submission, with actor classification supplied rather than presumed.
The post-launch period begins at 9:00am on 2 February 2026, reading the general effective date together with the specific launch time.
Footnote 3 applies to both marked options, XML and PDF; this circular does not expressly attach it to the web form.
Technical XML schema conformity, test arrangements, registration and substantive STR adequacy are separate controls.

citations.quote: licensed corporations, SFC-licensed virtual asset service providers and associated entities (collectively referred to as “licensed firms”)
Licensed firms are required to submit STRs to the JFIU via STREAMS 2 by one of the following means:
submission of an STR in an Extensible Markup Language (XML) format3;
uploading a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format3; or
completing the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.
upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.

readings.distinction: A completed web-form submission through STREAMS 2 without e-Cert can satisfy this selected control; an XML or prescribed-PDF submission without e-Cert cannot. A rival requiring e-Cert for all three methods lacks a footnote marker on option (c), so it is not proposed as an equally supported reading.

readings.subject: Post-launch STR channel, format and e-Cert control

assumptions: The specific blackout arrangements qualify application of the general calendar-date channel statement.
Direct contact is not treated as proof that JFIU accepted a completed STR.

citations.quote: will cease accepting STR submissions via STREAMS at 12:00am on 28 January 2026, and will resume accepting STR submissions at 9:00am on 2 February 2026 via STREAMS 2
for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

readings.distinction: An urgent matter at 8:30am on 2 February remains within the blackout contact arrangement; one at 9:30am falls within the post-launch channel control. Applying the channel rule from midnight without preserving the contact arrangement would disregard the express blackout endpoint.
questions: What makes an STR require urgent submission?
What steps beyond direct contact complete urgent reporting during blackout?
readings.statement: The selected blackout arrangement directs licensed firms with STRs requiring urgent submission to contact JFIU by the listed means until 9:00am on 2 February 2026. The source does not specify a complete filing procedure or establish that contact itself constitutes submission.
readings.subject: Urgent blackout contact exception

assumptions: Following implementation refers to the stated launch instant.
Resubmission is a separate obligation; its existence does not establish that the initial channel choice was compliant.
No deadline or completed-resubmission fact is inferred.

citations.quote: For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2.
The JFIU will provide guidance to facilitate the re-submission.
upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026

readings.distinction: An STR emailed to JFIU after launch triggers the express resubmission obligation. An urgent blackout contact before launch is not brought within that obligation by footnote 2 alone. Whether separate guidance requires later filing remains unresolved.
